properties.site-address: Victoria Cottage and Coal Yard, Thistle Hill, Knaresborough
properties.notes: Site is in the Green Belt, expectation that residential development should occupy no greater footprint than that of the existing buildings, and that there is an analysis of openness and how any proposal can be shown not to have any greater impact, taking into account the overall appearance, height and mass of the existing buildings and any new buildings proposed. Permission in principle for the demolition of existing buildings and erection of between 2 and 5 dwellings
properties.ownership-status: not owned by a public authority
